{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Ord_Radama.png|thumb|right|250px|Ord Radama]]
An '''Ordnance/Regional Depot''', abbreviated '''Ord''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that served as a military outpost during the height of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. These depots were set up as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] began to colonize rimward worlds from around [[13,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During the [[Pius Dea Era]], the Ordnance/Regional Depot worlds served as a network of forward military and scout bases for [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] units and [[Cathedral ship]]s led by missionaries expanding into the Frontier. These worlds were used to deploy [[Pius Dea]] forces during [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex]]'s anti-alien crusades.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Over a period of a few thousand years, the abbreviation stuck, and many planets from that era were commonly described with their "Ord" title. Many of the planets settled as military bases were designed to protect colonists, specifically [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists, who settled into the depths of space. It was often done out of a reaction of speciesism to protect Humans from indigenous [[Alien/Legends|aliens]].
